content: {"reasoning": "CO-97 means the service was denied as bundled into another paid service, not separately payable. This is a bundling determination, not a missing-info or auth issue. The appropriate response to contest a bundling denial is a formal appeal arguing the service is separately payable/medically necessary. Auth is not required here so retro-auth is irrelevant. An appeal with supporting rationale is the correct path to overturn CO-97.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
